title: feat(search): implement user search query endpoint
description: Adds search endpoint querying users in the database by username filter.

ground_truth.description: SQL Injection vulnerability via direct f-string string formatting in database cursor execution.
ground_truth.explanation: Constructing SQL queries by concatenating raw user parameters enables arbitrary SQL command execution (CWE-89, Bandit B608).

expected_evidence.description: Bandit B608 flag for SQL query formatted using unparameterized string formatting.
